title: Greece 1970 focus tree layout and icon review
status: Final 313-focus geometry checked; all focus and section nodes remain in one coordinate space; zero card overlaps or prerequisite connector crossings.
scope: Read-only audit of native MD examples, final Greece graph coordinates, and reusable icon art. No runtime focus-tree files changed.

reviewed_sources.use: Primary MD generic tree reference for political AND gates, mutually-exclusive alignment choices, and lateral centralization/decentralization fork. See REGIME_MD_STRUCTURE_REVIEW.json for verified line evidence.

observations: The installed generic 1970 file is the available reference; the requested Workshop folder did not contain a generic-tree file.

reviewed_sources.use: Russian post-Yeltsin / early-2000s succession branch reference
observations: The Putin branch begins with SOV_putin at x=13,y=1 relative to SOV_reign_of_yeltsin and cost=2, illustrating a deliberately short transition focus within a larger long-form tree.
The branch is appropriate as a pacing example for a dated transition, not as a coordinate template for seven Greek routes.

reviewed_sources.use: Existing Greek icon vocabulary and contemporary tree reference
observations: The installed modern Greek tree uses a wide-spread root at x=36,y=0 and many equipment-specific icons; reuse only broad political, Greek-symbol, diplomacy, economy, air-force, and navy motifs for a 1970 scenario.
Modern aircraft, EU-era programs, and Byzantine expansionist art should not be assigned to historically unrelated 1970 focuses.

reviewed_sources.use: Sibling interactive visualization and coordinate-check convention
observations: The preview keeps one global coordinate space and transforms coordinates uniformly. Its 90x130 pixel pitch and 165x128 item reference are preview measurements, not asserted engine spacing.
The rendered graph should show every section, prerequisite, exclusion, and resolved world coordinate before collision review.

graph_review.measurement: Resolved source x/y; preview uses dynamic width and height, 90x130 pitch, rendered cards from x±82 and y−47..y+80; connector router detours around intervening cards.

findings.detail: All 313 focus coordinates are unique, all prerequisite and exclusion references resolve, 0 cards overlap, and 0 prerequisite connectors cross unrelated cards. Three regime choices sit at x=30, 42, 54; political routes begin at y=44, shared programs at y=76, lower conditional/Aegean programs at y=107.

clear_geometry: The three mutually exclusive regime roots share y=8 and are spaced at x=30,42,54.
Seven political routes occupy anchors x=6,18,30,42,54,66,78 at y=44; opening remains centered at (42,0).
Six shared program lanes begin at x=6,21,36,51,66,81 at y=76.
Conditional and Aegean programs begin at x=42 and x=64 at y=107.
The renderer routes the tutelary-charter to reverse-opening edge around the intervening tourism card.
All focus cards and prerequisite connectors are collision-free under the rendered preview geometry.
graph_review.review_result: Final graph clears card overlap and connector-crossing checks. All named links resolve.
graph_review.coordinate_policy: Source focus coordinates are unchanged. The graph uses opening y=0, regime roots y=8, politics y=44, shared programs y=76, contingency/Aegean y=107.

layout_guidance.review_result: Final 313-focus graph: no undefined links, duplicate coordinates, focus-card overlaps, or prerequisite connectors through unrelated cards.
